[1] Update, October 7: Apple has now seeded both RC builds, with the same build numbers as the previous RC before the developer RC.

[2] In addition to seeding the second beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, Apple is now also seeding the first release candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. Here are the details.

[3] Legacy macOS versions continue to get security updates

[4] As is typical for minor updates to legacy versions of macOS, Apple today seeded the first release candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 without first seeding a regular beta.

[5] Apple last month seeded macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.1, both of which had two release candidates before being launched.

[6] Apple's release notes for the first RCs of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 only mention that the versions "provide important security fixes and are recommended for all users." Last month's updates contained a CoreGraphics security fix, details to follow:

[7] Apple's release notes for the first RCs of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 only mention that the versions "provide important security fixes and are recommended for all users." Apple is likely to publish the details of the fixes when macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 are released to the public, which is expected in the coming weeks alongside macOS 27.2 Golden Gate.

[8] The build number for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 RC 1 is 24H219, while the build number for macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 RC 1 is 25G320.

[9] Have you spotted anything new or different in today's RCs? Let us know in the comments.
